summary: Run :config (or ansible-navigator config) to review the Ansible configuration from an accessible ansible.cfg, or the defaults if none exists, and drill into each setting; some values come from the execution environment and show as non-default settings you cannot set in your config file.
questions: How do I review my ansible.cfg with ansible-navigator?
Why does ansible-navigator config show settings I did not set?
What does ansible-navigator config show if there is no ansible.cfg?
